beats.text: If you throw a bedsheet over Larry, put him in your garden shed, and charge kids one dollar to get scared...
Congratulations! You've built a haunted house!
A haunted house with zero scares... and one guy eating chips.
The kids don't scream. They laugh. Because they can see Larry's socks.
So you turn off the lights.
Now it's so dark, Larry walks straight into a wall. He yells, "JOHN!"
So you add creepy green lights and a fog machine.
Larry gets lost in his own fog. For three hours.
So you add fake spiders, skeletons, and creaky doors.
Larry sees his own spider and screams louder than the kids. Bro, it's YOUR haunted house.
But one tiny shed isn't enough anymore. So you build bigger. One room. Thirteen rooms. A whole haunted mansion.
Now you need secret doors, moving paintings, and trapdoors.
Larry tests the first trapdoor. Personally. "JOHN!"
So you hire real actors. Zombies, witches, and a vampire.
Larry asks a zombie for a selfie. Larry, you're supposed to scare them, not make friends.
But some people get too scared. So you add a chicken exit, a secret way out. Real haunted houses have them.
Larry uses it. At the entrance.
Then you add a graveyard, flying bats, and a giant iron gate. Larry's sheet gets stuck in the gate. Twice.
Congratulations! You've built the scariest haunted house in the world!
The line is three hours long. People faint at the door.
Then, at midnight... something floats in through the wall. A real ghost.
Everyone runs. The zombies run. Even the vampire runs.
The ghost floats past the fog. Not scared. Past the spiders. Not scared. Past the zombies. Not scared.
Then it turns the corner... and sees Larry. In his old one-dollar bedsheet. Eating chips.
The ghost screams and flies straight through the roof.
We spent ten million dollars on scares... and the only real ghost was scared of Larry.
